purpose: Teach: 亀裂/覚せい/熱烈/サリン/加速度/臨界/培養/入管

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、社会的亀裂を深めた事件史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered social division and historical incidents in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. Slight pause after the name—giving him space to settle. Clear curiosity, not interrogation. Voice rises gently at the end, genuinely interested in what he'll say.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、覚せい剤事件の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the sociology of stimulant cases.
lines.style: Soft, careful start. Slight hesitation—he's checking his own phrasing. Steady delivery once he commits to the sentence. Respectful of the question, not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、熱烈なファン文化の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you looked into intense fan cultures in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle redirection. She's thinking as she speaks—testing his recollection or offering a gentle correction. Warm but observant. No edge, just careful attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、サリン事件後の社会対応を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined how society responded after the sarin incident.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. He's tracking what he actually wrote versus what was suggested. Even pace, genuine. A small nod in his voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 物体運動の加速度解析を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You analyzed acceleration in object motion for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Bright, engaged. She's moved to a different topic—perhaps testing across his work, or genuinely curious. Conversational, not lecturing. Open and warm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、原子炉の臨界事故史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I explored the history of reactor critical accidents.
lines.style: He's building confidence now. Slightly clearer enunciation. Still respectful, but more present. A small steadiness has entered his voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、細胞培養技術史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the history of cell culture techniques, didn't you?
lines.style: Same warm, reflective quality as before. She's clearly working through his portfolio with genuine interest. Unhurried, appreciative of each piece.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、入管法改正の論点を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the key points in immigration law reform.
lines.style: A small breath before starting. He's settling into the rhythm now. Slight weariness at the edge—this is thorough—but also a quiet resolve. Gentle close, like he's done well.
